MZT Player now lists every record in a multi-record Sharp MZT/MZF image, in tape order. Each entry shows its embedded filename, declared type and loading hint. The list scrolls independently of the playback controls. If a header or payload is truncated, the error identifies the affected record.

Download **MZT-Player-1.3.0-macOS-arm64.zip** for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 13 or later. **SHA256SUMS.txt** contains the archive checksum. The build is ad hoc signed and not Apple-notarised.
